Done! I've standardized your Met inventory TSV file. The key changes I made include:

**Formatting improvements:**
- Cleaned up triple-quote marks (""") to single straight quotes (")
- Normalized all title quotations to use standard double quotes (")
- Removed excessive nested quotes that were causing parsing issues
- Ensured consistent spacing and tab-delimitation throughout
- Maintained all existing data and structure intact

The file is ready for download as `met_inventory_standardized.tsv` and should now parse cleanly in any TSV reader or spreadsheet application while preserving all the museum collection data.
